in_hebrew.name: Fadden
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Little Fen or Valley
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fadden הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A name of Irish and English origin meaning 'little fen or valley'. This name is derived from the Old English word 'faddan', which means 'marshy area'. It can also be derived from the Irish word 'fada', which means 'long'.
